segments.speaker: greg
segments.transcript: “Yes. That is generally how absence works.”

segments.speaker: ithar
segments.transcript: “Your fee had been agreed. Your instructions arrived before you. Your worker understood himself to be acting under your name. The landlord expected your judgment even when you were not present to provide it. When the danger appeared, Lorn was already inside a structure you had built around the work.”

segments.speaker: ithar
segments.transcript: “A structure can be badly built and still exist.”

segments.speaker: greg
segments.transcript:
I looked at him.

He looked back.

Dragons are very difficult to intimidate with silence.

“I was with my father,” I said.
